This image shows a Stud Hidden Placket (2 Buttons) dress shirt front. The outer placket folds over and conceals the visible buttons, leaving only the top collar button and sometimes the lowest fastening point visible.

Hidden Placket Geometry
Finished Visible Front Placket Width

Typical bespoke measurement:

PW=3.0 cm to 3.5 cmPW = 3.0\text{ cm to }3.5\text{ cm}
Hidden Fly Extension

The concealed layer behind the placket is usually:

HE=PW+2.0 cmHE = PW + 2.0\text{ cm}

For a 3 cm finished placket:

HE=3+2=5 cmHE = 3 + 2 = 5\text{ cm}
Total Cut Width

For a classic hidden placket:

CW=(PW×2)+HECW = (PW \times 2) + HE

Example:

CW=(3×2)+5CW = (3 \times 2) + 5 CW=11 cmCW = 11\text{ cm}

Many bespoke shirtmakers round this to:

10.5−11.5 cm10.5 - 11.5\text{ cm}

Formal Bespoke Hidden Placket Formula

For any desired finished placket width PP:

Hidden extension:

H=P+2H = P + 2

Total cut width:

C=3P+2C = 3P + 2

Example with 3.5 cm placket:

C=(3×3.5)+2C = (3 \times 3.5)+2 C=12.5 cmC = 12.5\text{ cm}
